entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: Imperial assassin and later imperial regent of Madara on Dominaria, who schemes against Nicol Bolas's loyal servants.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Emperor of Madara; a planeswalker who rewards Overdark's ambition with the regency.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Imperial champion who renounces his title, becomes Overdark's nemesis and kills him.

entities.name: Marhault Elsdragon
entities.description: Kentsu general of Madara, decapitated by Jorgan Hage.

entities.name: Jorgan Hage
entities.description: Second in command of the kentsu, possessed by Overdark's assassin powers and made general.

entities.name: Xira Arien
entities.description: Bolas's most skilled assassin, used by Overdark against the Edemi rebels.

entities.name: Lady Orca
entities.description: Sent to terrorize the Edemi islands, she turns on the kentsu.

entities.name: Zalgadib
entities.description: An efreet who guarded Overdark's keep under a 300-year bargain.

entities.name: Kolo Meha
entities.description: Sent by Tetsuo to destroy Overdark's keep, killing Zalgadib.

entities.name: Kei Takahashi
entities.description: Tetsuo's healer, infected by Arien to lure Tetsuo.

entities.name: Halfdane
entities.description: A shapeshifter stationed on Kusho to poison the island's mana lines.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: The empire on Dominaria ruled by Bolas.

entities.name: Edemi Islands
entities.description: Islands that rebelled against the empire.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: The conflict when the Edemi Islands rebelled against the empire.

events.summary: Bolas sends Overdark to reclaim the rebellious Edemi Islands; Overdark plots to kill Tetsuo, but his minions and serpent generator are defeated.
events.quote: When the Edemi Islands rebelled against the empire, Bolas first sent Overdark to reclaim them.

events.summary: Overdark disobeys Bolas's orders, sending agents to the islands, including Halfdane and a forged decree to bring Orca.
events.quote: But Overdark disobeyed the direct orders of the emperor and sent agents to the islands anyway.

events.summary: Orca turns on the kentsu and Hage decapitates Elsdragon, usurping the title of general as Overdark's minion.
events.quote: Hage decapitated Elsdragon and usurped the title of general

events.summary: Bolas, impressed by his ambition, names Overdark imperial regent.
events.quote: Bolas then awarded Overdark with the title of imperial regent.

events.summary: Tetsuo renounces his title as imperial champion and swears vengeance on Overdark.
events.quote: Tetsuo had renounced his title of imperial champion

events.summary: Kolo Meha destroys Overdark's keep at Tetsuo's order, killing Zalgadib.
events.quote: Kolo Meha was ordered to destroy the keep by Tetsuo Umezawa, killing Zalgadib.

events.summary: Tetsuo fights his way to the Imperial Shrine, kills Overdark and absorbs his powers.
events.quote: Tetsuo killed Overdark and absorbed his powers to use them against Bolas.

relations.note: One-on-one combat at the Imperial Shrine.
relations.quote: Tetsuo killed Overdark and absorbed his powers to use them against Bolas.
